    a += b;
    if (a >= mod) a -= mod;
    return a;
}

inline int mul(int a, int b) {
    return (ll)a * b % mod;
}

int C[N][N], f[N], g[N];
int dp[N][N], dp2[N][N];

int main() {
    int n, m;
    scanf("%d%d%d", &n, &m, &mod);

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        C[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            C[i][j+1] = add(C[i-1][j+1], C[i-1][j]);
        }
    }
    
    // Base cases for f and g
    f[0] = 1;
    g[0] = 0;
    
    // Compute f[i] and g[i] for i from 1 to m
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {

                coef = mul(coef, C[j+k][j]);

                int val = add(mul(dp2[i][j], f[k]), mul(dp[i][j], g[k]));
                val = mul(C[j+k][j], val);
                dp2[i+k+1][j+k] = add(dp2[i+k+1][j+k], val);
